_comment: Measured wall-seconds per spec file, summed across workers. Feeds scripts/e2e-shard-plan.js, which bin-packs specs into balanced shards — Playwright's own --shard splits by TEST COUNT, which left one shard doing 473s of work while another did 64s. Regenerate with: node scripts/e2e-shard-plan.js --measure <runId>. A spec missing from this file still runs; it is assigned the median weight, so the only cost of stale data is imperfect balance, never a skipped test.
_source: GitHub Actions run 31429108622 (6 shards, 156 tests, 1486s total)

_notes.pos-coupon-apply.spec.ts: Measured at 70.0s for ONE store. Now runs once per store (3 on dev-next) and the non-default stores each pay a lazy OAuth, so it is weighted at 210 rather than its last measurement. Re-measure once a full run lands.
_notes.server-created-visibility.spec.ts: Measured 15.7m locally against dev-pro (2026-08-21, 3 directional tests, one worker): each arrival rode the ~5-min eco cadence poll rather than the fast change-signal path. Weighted at the slow-path cost so the shard planner never packs it as a median spec; re-measure once a CI run lands.
